timeline.summary: The Thrulls, bred for sacrifice, turn on the Order of the Ebon Hand with gruesome results.
timeline.quote: the Thrulls eventually turned on their masters, the Order of the Ebon Hand, with gruesome results

citation.text: Basal Thrull (Fallen Empires, 1994), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Thrulls breed at a terrifying pace and overwhelm the Order of the Ebon Hand.
timeline.quote: In the end, they overwhelmed the Order of the Ebon Hand.

citation.text: Breeding Pit (Fallen Empires, 1994), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Endrek Sahr creates the first Thrulls by introducing alchemic elements into the Order's necromancy.
timeline.quote: To create the first Thrulls, I only introduced alchemic elements into the Order's necromancy

citation.text: Basal Thrull (Fallen Empires, 1994), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Order's thrulls overrun the whole of Sarpadia.
timeline.quote: the entire continent was overrun by the thrulls

citation.text: "Dominaria (plane)", section "Dark Age". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sarpadia is plunged into chaos; the Ebon Hand is torn apart by a Thrull Rebellion and only thrulls and thallids remain.
timeline.quote: The Ebon Hand would be torn apart inside out by a Thrull Rebellion.

citation.work: Fallen Empires on the World of Magic: The Gathering
citation.text: "Fallen Empires on the World of Magic: The Gathering", section "Aftermath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Thelon creates the thallids by infusing fungus with green mana and borrowed dark rites.
timeline.quote: Thelon created the thallids by infusing natural fungus with green mana

citation.text: "Fungus", section "Thallids". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The dwarven kingdom falls to a chaos-driven army of orcs and goblins, followed by the Ebon Hand falling to the thrulls and the elves to the thallids.
timeline.quote: starting with the fall of the dwarven kingdom to a chaos-driven army of orcs and goblins

citation.text: "Sarpadia", section "Fall of the Empires". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tymolin is captured by Vaylesh and the Ebon Hand and stabbed to death by Farrel.
timeline.quote: which backfired when Farrel stabbed Tymolin to death.

citation.text: "Tevesh Szat", section "Transformation to Tevesh Szat". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Endrek Sahr creates the first thrulls on Sarpadia as slaves for the Order of the Ebon Hand.
timeline.quote: the thrulls were first created by Endrek Sahr as slaves for the Order of the Ebon Hand

citation.text: "Thrull", section "Sarpadian Thrulls". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Reod Dai convinces thrulls to turn on their masters; they annihilate the Order and wipe out all non-thrull life in Sarpadia except the thallids; Jherana Rure is killed by thrull assassins.
timeline.quote: annihilating the Order and, save for the thallids , eventually wiping out all non-thrull life in Sarpadia.

citation.text: "Thrull", section "Sarpadian Thrulls". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Order orders Sahr's execution over his derelor; Vaylesh's derelor is struck down by Tevesh Szat's Fireball.
timeline.quote: This eventually led to an order for Sahr's execution.

citation.text: "Thrull", section "Sarpadian Thrulls". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Reod arranges a trade deal between the Ebon Hand and Havenwood that creates thallids, and is hired by the Elder Druids to distract Icatia.
timeline.quote: creating the thallids , a plentiful, if somewhat bland, food source

citation.text: "Reod Dai", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Followers of Leitbur make it their mission to eradicate the Order of the Ebon Hand.
timeline.quote: who made it their mission to eradicate the Order of the Ebon Hand.

citation.text: Order of Leitbur (Pro Tour Collector Set, 1996), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: At Teedmar Reod and Eliza are ambushed by an Ebon Hand wizard, who reveals thallids have gained sentience and the Hand caused the volcano to erupt.
timeline.quote: they had caused the volcano near Teedmar to erupt, to kill the dwarves for selling weapons to Icatia

citation.text: "And Peace Shall Sleep", section "At Teedmar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The volcano buries Teedmar under lava while the wizard teleports Reod and Eliza to Achtep Keep.
timeline.quote: they find the city buried under the lava

citation.text: "And Peace Shall Sleep", section "At Teedmar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Eliza rescues Reod from torture, the thrulls kill the Ebon Hand, and Reod promises to aid their revolt.
timeline.quote: The thrulls kill the members of the Ebon Hand

citation.text: "And Peace Shall Sleep", section "At Achtep Keep". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Thrulls overwhelm the Order of the Ebon Hand.
timeline.quote: The thrulls bred at a terrifying pace. In the end, they overwhelmed the Order of the Ebon Hand.

citation.text: Breeding Pit (Fifth Edition, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Laquatus reaches Kirtar at the Order encampment; Pianna demands the sphere and Kirtar plots a coup.
timeline.quote: The aven reluctantly complies but plots a coup

citation.text: "Odyssey (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kirtar tries to gain control of the Order with the sphere but its power devastates the city, leaving him and Pianna dead; Turg takes the artifact.
timeline.quote: leaving him and Pianna dead, and the city in ruins.

citation.text: "Odyssey (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Pianna is nearly killed by wolves while protecting loggers and is saved by Order reinforcements.
timeline.quote: Were it not for the timely intervention of Order reinforcements

citation.text: "Pianna", section "Protecting Krosa". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Laquatus starts a civil war in the Mer Empire and schemes with both Order and Cabal; the First sacrifices Skellum in the pits, devastating Chainer.
timeline.quote: In his plotting, he sacrifices Skellum, who dies in the pits to appease them.

citation.text: "Chainer's Torment", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Order clerics contain the Mirari's energy to delay Otaria's demise.
timeline.quote: Every day, Order clerics contain as much of the Mirari's energy as possible, hoping to delay Otaria's demise.

citation.text: Aura Extraction (Onslaught, 2002), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Thrulls bred for sacrifice turn on and overwhelm their masters, the Order of the Ebon Hand.
timeline.quote: the thrulls eventually turned on their masters, the Order of the Ebon Hand, with gruesome results.

citation.text: Basal Thrull (Masters Edition, 2007), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Order of the Ebon Hand breeds Thrulls as sacrifices.
timeline.quote: The Thrulls were bred by the Order of the Ebon Hand as sacrifices

citation.work: How to Design a Hellion and More!
citation.text: "How to Design a Hellion and More!". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Aug 2008. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Thrull subspecies bred for intelligence and combat overwhelm their masters.
timeline.quote: Thrull subspecies selected for intelligence and combat eventually overwhelmed their masters.

citation.work: How to Design a Hellion and More!
citation.text: "How to Design a Hellion and More!". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Aug 2008. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Attacked by Order forces, Chainer unleashes horrors from his dementia space upon Cabal City.
timeline.quote: Chainer unleashed every horror from his dementia space upon Cabal City.

citation.text: "Battle for the Mirari", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Reod plans a thrull rebellion; some thrulls betray him and Genkr tortures him.
timeline.quote: Reod then hatched a plan to start a thrull rebellion.

citation.text: "Achtep Keep", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The thrull rebellion overwhelms the Ebon Hand, leaving Achtep Keep in ruin.
timeline.quote: the thrull rebellion eventually overwhelmed them completely, leaving Achtep Keep in ruin

citation.text: "Achtep Keep", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Order of the Ebon Hand sets off a volcanic eruption wiping out Teedmar and supplies troops under Ivra Jursdotter to aid the orcs and goblins.
timeline.quote: setting off a volcanic eruption that wiped out the city of Teedmar

citation.text: "Crimson Peaks", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sahr creates armor thrulls and thrull wizards.
timeline.quote: creating the thrull wizard to assist in ceremonies

citation.text: "Endrek Sahr", section "Experimentation". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Ebon Hand captures a Yawgmoth Priest, who refuses Sahr's questioning and predicts his punishment in Phyrexia.
timeline.quote: the Yawgmoth Priest refused to give any information

citation.text: "Endrek Sahr", section "The interrogation". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sahr creates the derelor; the drain on black mana leads to his execution.
timeline.quote: This failure prompted Sahr's execution.

citation.text: "Endrek Sahr", section "Execution". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Reod Dai's magic gives thallids sentience and he incites the thrull rebellion against the Ebon Hand.
timeline.quote: Reod Dai then incited a rebellion among the thrulls against their Ebon Hand masters.

citation.text: "Fall of the Sarpadian Empires", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The thrull rebellion destroys the Ebon Hand, thallids overrun Havenwood, and Icatia is conquered.
timeline.quote: the thrull rebellion destroyed the Ebon Hand

citation.text: "Fall of the Sarpadian Empires", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Farrel ambushes Tymolin and Tev; Tev dispels the mantle from Sianna and is then lost in Havenwood, letting Tymolin be captured.
timeline.quote: Tev dispelled the mantle from Sianna, defeating and angering Farrel

citation.text: "Farrelites", section "Death of Farrel". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tev arrives as Tevesh Szat and incinerates the Farrelites and Ebon Hand, killing Farrel and Sianna.
timeline.quote: incinerating all present, including Farrel and Sianna

citation.text: "Farrelites", section "Death of Farrel". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Oliver breaks from the priesthood, finding the Order too lenient with the Ebon Hand, and gathers followers who become the Farrelites.
timeline.quote: Oliver broke away from the priesthood because he found the Order too lenient

citation.text: "Oliver Farrel", section "Formation of the Farrelites". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Endrek Sahr creates thrulls to serve as slaves and ritual sacrifices.
timeline.quote: created Thrulls to serve them as slaves and ritual sacrifices

citation.text: "Order of the Ebon Hand", section "Creation of the thrulls". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Thrulls breed rapidly and overwhelm the Order; Sahr is ordered executed but a time rift pulls him into the future.
timeline.quote: A time rift seemed to be the only reprieve for Sahr, as he was pulled into the future

citation.text: "Order of the Ebon Hand", section "Creation of the thrulls". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vaylesh captures Tymolin Loneglade and lures Oliver Farrel to combat to draw the Farrelites into the open.
timeline.quote: Vaylesh , a priestess of the Order of the Ebon Hand, captured Tymolin Loneglade

citation.text: "Order of the Ebon Hand", section "Encounter with the Farrelites". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

citation.text: "Thallid", section "Sarpadia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
